original_test_intent: Measure mixed random 50% read/50% write SSD performance at QD1, 512-byte blocks and one job and compare IOPS, bandwidth and latency against the approved device specification.
original_method: Record fio/platform/device identity and health; preserve logs; obtain a disposable non-OS target and destructive authorization; correct randread to a bounded randrw/rwmixread=50 job with explicit target/size; verify topology; run once; capture complete fio and device telemetry; leave remount/reinitialization to the owner.
manual_activity: Storage/data owner designates a disposable target, authorizes overwrite and approves the corrected profile, runtime, spec and recovery; agent may execute afterward.
required_inputs: Exact disposable device/path, model/serial/firmware/capacity and raw-filesystem/RAID/LVM/NVMe mapping
Explicit confirmation that target is empty, unmounted, not OS/swap/in-use, and data loss is authorized
Verified fio binary/version and corrected randrw/rwmixread=50, iodepth1, bs512, numjobs1, target, size/range and runtime
Versioned storage performance thresholds and aggregation/tolerance
SMART/health, thermal/power/error abort, cleanup, remount/reinitialization and invalid-run policy
safety_requirements: Map device serial through mounts, holders, RAID/LVM/NVMe and verify it is not OS or production storage
Require explicit data-loss and runtime approval before any write
Validate job syntax/profile without starting I/O
Stop on target mismatch, unexpected mount/holder, media/SMART error, thermal/power limit or instability
No automatic retry, formatting, recovery, remount or widening of target range
agent_execution_scope: Collect device mapping, health and baseline evidence and validate corrected job
Run only the exact approved bounded fio job against the designated target
Stop fio and collect final health/log evidence while leaving target isolated
Do not infer target, alter ratio/runtime/range, rerun, format/remount or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Resolve title/procedure conflict and approve corrected 50/50 profile
Designate disposable target and authorize data loss
Define storage thresholds, duration and abort/recovery policy

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title requires 50/50 mixed read/write, but the literal job uses randread only. It also omits target and size, uses `./fio` after package installation and provides no measurable specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A disposable target, verified fio binary, corrected profile, specification and approvals can be supplied; absence today is a package/confirmation prerequisite.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row3 Wistron-Storage-00010-V003: approve the intended 50/50 randrw profile instead of the literal randread job; designate an exact disposable non-OS device/path with serial/topology mapping and authorize data loss; approve verified fio binary, target/size/range, raw-versus-filesystem mode, QD1/512B/one-job semantics, 43,200-second or bounded runtime, performance thresholds/tolerance, SMART/media/thermal/power abort, cleanup/remount/reinitialization and invalid-run policy.

review_improvement: Prevents a read-only job from being misreported as 50/50 and adds mandatory data-loss authorization and serial-bound target safeguards.
independent_technical_reasoning: `rw=randread` generates no write workload, so it cannot test the title's 50/50 mixture. Correcting it to randrw introduces destructive writes; with no filename or size, execution has no trustworthy target boundary. Therefore both the semantic correction and physical device ownership mapping must precede performance interpretation.
